primitives.name: Disk usage analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Disk cleanup — 2026-10-02 Baseline: `df` reported 4.2G free of 476G (100% used).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_total': 'Total disk capacity in gigabytes', 'U_free': 'Free space remaining in gigabytes'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes filesystem accounting aligns with physical storage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Full capacity operation when U_{free} \ll U_total.

layer2.mapping: Maps to portfolio liquidation constraints where U_{free} represents available capital and U_{total} represents total assets.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time monitoring of free space thresholds to prevent system crashes.

primitives.name: iOS backup storage
primitives.verbatim_quote: The largest roots were not caches: - `C:\Users\Garrett\Apple\MobileSync` 68.85 GB — iPhone backups.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_ios': 'Storage consumed by iOS device backups in gigabytes'}
primitives.assumptions: Backups are incremental and may contain redundant data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Significant storage hog when multiple devices or old backups exist.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to database transaction logs or snapshot storage in financial systems.
layer2.telemetry: Backup size trends over time indicate data growth patterns.

primitives.name: Docker WSL state
primitives.verbatim_quote: A Docker prune was not run; the daemon was not confirmed idle, and a vhdx compact needs a human.
primitives.assumptions: WSL disk images grow monotonically without compaction.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Dynamic allocation overhead when container layers accumulate.

layer2.mapping: Relates to memory fragmentation in high-frequency trading engines requiring manual garbage collection.
layer2.telemetry: WSL disk image file size as a proxy for active container state.

primitives.name: Regenerable cache cleaning
primitives.verbatim_quote: A Docker prune was not run; the daemon was not confirmed idle, and a vhdx compact needs a human.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_cleaned': 'Cache storage explicitly marked for deletion in gigabytes'}
primitives.assumptions: Cache contents can be rebuilt deterministically from source.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cache invalidation boundary where stale data is purged.

layer2.mapping: Maps to clearing stale market data feeds in a trading system.
layer2.telemetry: Cache hit rates before and after cleaning to measure effectiveness.

DiskUsageAnalysis provides the global budget constraint U_total = U_free + U_used. iOSBackupStorage quantifies a major non-evictable component B_ios, while DockerWSLState captures the latent growth of virtual machine images. RegenerableCacheCleaning targets the only part of the state that can be safely reduced without loss of information. The interplay between these components defines the effective free space available for new operations. In a broader sense, this mirrors resource allocation in stochastic environments where some assets are locked (e.g., collateral) and others can be liquidated (e.g., cached data). The key failure mode is assuming that freeing space via deletion guarantees immediate availability, which requires understanding the underlying filesystem semantics and the immutability of certain data.
